pullRequests.body:
Matches 69 US functions (50 in net.text, 4 in game, 3 in core, 12 in level overlays): near misses from my earlier batches and drafts that are now exact, plus a few from a fresh batch.
How they were matched
Most were a few instructions off. What closed them:

Comparison operand order: retail loads the right-hand field first in a->x < a->y; written a->y > a->x it matches. This closed a family of net.text assert getters at once (func_01F056C8, func_01F0574C, func_01F060F4, func_01F06248,…
